scenario_interpretation: Analyst-defined adverse, base and favorable assumptions. These are not probability bounds, calibrated prediction intervals, management guidance or price targets. Outcomes can fall outside the range.
limits: A within-quarter fundamental forecast with no realized target-quarter outcome.
The forecast does not constitute full valuation, governance, cash-conversion or position-sizing underwriting.
Seasonal anchors use one prior year and can break when business mix changes.
rationale: The September dividend season is a poor proxy for December. Model dividends, interest, rental income, P&L fair-value gains, expenses and after-tax associates separately. The base assumes zero net P&L fair-value gain, rather than predicting market direction.

verified_facts.fact: Q2 dividend income 114.33cr, interest 6.98cr, net P&L fair-value loss 2.34cr, rental income 3.33cr, other income 0.65cr and expenses 13.00cr.
Q2 own PBT 109.95cr plus after-tax associates 26.68cr minus tax 20.71cr gives owner PAT 115.92cr.
Prior December dividends 13.21cr were far below prior September dividends 116.44cr. Prior December P&L fair-value gain was 33.35cr and associates 31.26cr.
Fair-value OCI and equity-disposal gains credited directly to retained earnings are outside the reported-PAT target.

assumptions.label: Dividends
assumptions.basis: Near the prior December 13.21cr, with no assumption that September dividend income repeats.

assumptions.label: P&L fair-value movement
assumptions.basis: Neutral central assumption for an unpredictable market-dependent item. It is neither verified recurring income nor a claim that the gain cannot recur.

assumptions.label: Own-profit tax and associates
assumptions.base: 17 percent on own PBT, then 31cr associates
assumptions.basis: Tax is an approximation. Associates are after tax. The adverse loss case assumes no tax benefit is recognized.

disconfirming_evidence_to_watch: An unusual December dividend or large P&L fair-value gain could move reported PAT well above the base.
Associate results are material and can move independently of the parent dividend calendar.
main_takeaway: A sharp modeled sequential PAT decline can be seasonality, without implying a comparable decline in portfolio asset value.
